tei:titleStmt.tei:title: כַּוָּנָה לִפְנֵי עֲבוֹדָה בְּאַדְמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ
Kavvanah before working with the holy soil of Erets Yisrael, by Rabbi Shalom Ḥayyim Sharabi (ca. 1911)

tei:div.tei:head: Kavvanah before working with the holy soil of Erets Yisrael, by Rabbi Shalom Ḥayyim Sharabi (ca. 1911)

tei:l.tei:note: This prayer is to be said while holding the hoe that will be used for the planting:

tei:lg.tei:l: To unify the name of the blessed Holy One and their Shekhinah,
with fear and compassion,
I hereby take this hoe (ma’ader)
which in gematria is equivalent to [the divine name] Shadai,
to eliminate all thorns and thistles,
and to till with it all the [divine holy] sparks (nitsotsim)
from within our soil,
the holy soil.
May it be your will, Hashem our elo’ah and elo’ah of our ancestors,
creator of borders and the returner of children to their border,
that you will strengthen us and make our path successful
in laboring our holy labor
in the holy soil.
And may we merit seeing the purification of the soil of Yisra’el
from her impurity
in the time in which she is shaking off
wickedness from herself
And may she return to her first husband
with the rebuilding of Tsiyon and Yerushalayim
Amen, may it be your will.

tei:note.tei:p: The first line presenting instructional text on holding the hoe appears in versions circulated on the web in the context of Tu Bishvat tree planting programs. The line does not appear in the earliest versions of the prayer I could find, published between 1991 and 1997 (see below, “Sources”).
The numerical equivalence of מעד״ר and שד״י is 314

Genesis 3:18, Genesis 5:29 (and Rashi on Genesis 5:29.1). This is also a textual reference to a phrase found in other post-Lurianic prayers, for example this from the prayer read prior to reading the Sefer Tehilim: “ותהא קריאת מזמורי תהלים רצויה לפניך לזמר עריצים ולהכרית כל החוחים והקוצים הסובבים השושנה העליונה. ולחבר אשת נעורים עם דודה באהבה ואחוה שלום וְרֵעוּת”. (מתוך היהי רצון שאומרים קודם תהלים)
